title: Cloud Native Summit
desc: Explore the building blocks of modern cloud infrastructure, from containers and orchestration to resilient, scalable applications. Meet fellow builders and learn through practical sessions.

title: CodeSprint 24
desc: A fast-paced coding challenge built for curious problem-solvers. Sharpen your logic, collaborate with peers and tackle algorithmic puzzles in a friendly competitive setting.

title: AI Build Lab
desc: Turn ideas into intelligent prototypes in an approachable, hands-on introduction to AI and machine learning workflows. Bring your curiosity; leave with a new perspective.

title: Bug Bash: Find & Fix
desc: Put your debugging instincts to the test. Trace unexpected behavior, inspect code, and work systematically to find and fix issues across a realistic web application.

title: CyberShield Workshop
desc: Learn core security principles, threat awareness and secure development habits through guided examples and collaborative discussion.

title: FutureTech Talks
desc: A series of short, thought-provoking talks about emerging technology, practical innovation and the ideas shaping the next generation of computing.

title: Hack the Horizon
desc: Build, experiment and collaborate on a creative technology idea in a high-energy mini hackathon. Teams will pitch their solutions at the end of the day.

title: Design Systems 101
desc: Discover how thoughtful design systems create consistent, accessible interfaces. Explore typography, spacing, reusable components and the details that make products feel polished.
